title: The accordion years
author: Ana Popescu
body:
She started playing again the year my grandfather died, which I only understood much later. Every Thursday she would come down with the accordion in its brown case and say "only one song, I am very rusty" and then play for forty minutes.

The one she always finished with was about a man going home. She never told us what it was called. When I finally found the sheet music in her notebook it had no title on it either — just the notes, and in the margin, in her small blue handwriting, the words: "for later".
